video_title: Deni Avdija Postgame Interview | Portland Trail Blazers 116, San Antonio Spurs 111 | Nov. 25, 2026

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the team's collective effort in the win
quotes.excerpt: We stayed together. We gave all our effort defensively, offensively. Coaching staff, everybody was locked in today.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Deni, extremely competitive game from beginning to end. How did you find a way to win this one down the stretch?

text_blocks.speaker: Deni Avdija
text_blocks.text: We stayed together. We gave all our effort defensively, offensively. Coaching staff, everybody was locked in today.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the importance of team defense
quotes.excerpt: We were connected today defensively. We did what we needed to do. Shout out to everybody.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You guys got some huge stops in those last few minutes. Just how important was your team defense tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Deni Avdija
text_blocks.text: Team defense, as I said, we were connected today defensively. We did what we needed to do. Shout out to everybody on the team. And that's about it. I'm pretty exhausted.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the support from the Portland fans
quotes.excerpt: I definitely feel the love and we want them to come every night and support.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: But everyone in this building are Deni fans. Could you feel the love tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Deni Avdija
text_blocks.text: I definitely feel the love and we want them to come every night and support and be loud because they're a part of us and we love them.
